title: Pointed gourd (Parval): modeled ₹997/qtl left, Vansda → Surat
summary: January 2021: reported pointed gourd (Parval) prices at Vansda and Surat imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 95% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹997 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 2 same-variety market pairs screened for pointed gourd (Parval) in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Surat report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Vansda (Gujarat) and Surat (Gujarat) both reported pointed gourd (Parval) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 22 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Vansda reported a median ₹4,875 per quintal. Surat reported a median ₹6,250 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,688/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,688 per quintal, and Surat was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 92 km by road
scenes.caption: 92 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹20/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,078 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹775 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Surat report, the rule selects 21 of 21 modeled shipping days. 20 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹997 per quintal (₹670 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pointed gourd (Parval) route from Vansda to Surat was positive on 95% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹99,700, or ₹67,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pointed gourd (Parval)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹20/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pointed gourd (Parval) route from Vansda to Surat was positive on 95% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹99,700, or ₹67,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
